title: Find Lowest Common Ancestor
desc: Find the closest shared ancestor of two nodes.
input: Node1 = Child A1, Node2 = Child A2

steps.msg: Node 1 path: Child A1 -> Parent A -> Grandparent
Node 2 path: Child A2 -> Parent A -> Grandparent

code.python:
def find_lca(root, p, q):
    if not root or root == p or root == q: return root
    left = find_lca(root.left, p, q)
    right = find_lca(root.right, p, q)
    if left and right: return root
    return left or right

code.python:
def binaryTreePaths(root):
    res = []
    def dfs(node, path):
        if not node: return
        if not node.left and not node.right:
            res.append(path + str(node.val))
            return
        dfs(node.left, path + str(node.val) + '->')
        dfs(node.right, path + str(node.val) + '->')
    dfs(root, "")
    return res
